params.expression:
new Promise(res => setTimeout(() => res(JSON.stringify({
  title: document.title,
  inputs: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input')).map(i => ({id:i.id, type:i.type, ph:i.placeholder, val:(i.value||'').slice(0,20)})).slice(0,25),
  selects: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('select')).map(s => ({id:s.id, name:s.name, opts:Array.from(s.options).map(o=>o.text).slice(0,10)})).slice(0,10),
  buttons: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).map(b => (b.innerText||'').trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,20),
  labels: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('label')).map(l => (l.innerText||'').trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,20)
})), 1000))
